messages:
oncall-bot: ALERT: high tail latency detected for Lotus dedicated pool (pool-lotus-1). 95th=2.3s, baseline=0.35s. Paging @devon @alex. incident_id=INC-2026-045

devon: taking it. grabbing recent traces and prometheus windows now. any reports from the customer?

alex: looking at the node list — gpu-7 shows repeated OOMs and elevated kernel stalls. a single tenant session 'nlp-service-9' is causing sustained long sequences + huge batch growth. looks like noisy neighbor.

chris: starting drain on gpu-7 from pool-lotus-1 to reduce impact. running: 
```
ctl node drain --node gpu-7 --pool pool-lotus-1 --reason "noisy-tenant-mitigation" --timeout 300
```

oncall-bot: ACTION: automatic fallback triggered: sessions on drained node are being routed to model-compact-v2 by policy "latency-fallback".

kevin.lotus: we started seeing timeouts in prod at 12:07 PDT. can you confirm what's being done and an ETA?

maria: sorry about this, @kevin.lotus — team is on it. I'll post an ETA in ~10m and keep you updated every 15.

devon: implemented interim mitigations: throttled batch_size for tenant nlp-service-9 from 32 -> 8 and enabled per-tenant KV cache limits. 95th latency dropped to ~0.42s within 3 mins. continuing to monitor for 15m window. :white_check_mark:

tara: collecting flamegraphs and request traces for the affected sessions. uploading artifacts to the incident bucket: s3://redwood-incidents/INC-2026-045/traces.tar.gz (will share presigned link).

alex: preliminary root cause hypothesis: an upstream data pipeline started emitting unusually long prompts which, combined with continuous batching, overflowed the execution kernel and triggered OOMs on gpu-7. batching policy didn't cap per-tenant batch growth.

chris: long-term mitigation options: (1) enforce per-tenant batch caps at the router layer, (2) add tenant-level sequence-length guards, (3) reserve a "quarantine" isolated node pool (lotus-isolated-1) for noisy tenants. I can spin up a spare node if we approve.

maria: for customer comms and remediation: proposal draft -> offer one month pro-rated credit equal to 10% of Lotus committed spend for the incident window + provide one reserved spare node for 3 months at no charge while we tune policies. drafting exec note and RCA now.

devon: agree on quarantine pool. also will include exact timeline and commands used in the RCA. handing to post-incident follow-up: assigning to @maria and @alex for customer comms and remediation plan.

chris: action items for follow-up: - run targeted replay against lotus-isolated-1 to validate quota rules - add unit test for batch-cap enforcement - schedule a postmortem with Lotus CS and engineering leads

maria: I will share the RCA draft and exec note in #customer-success in ~45m. @kevin.lotus I'll DM the exec summary first and ask if the credit + spare-node proposal is acceptable.

kevin.lotus: thanks for the quick response. appreciate the interim fix — please keep me posted and share the exec note.

oncall-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigation in place, latency returned to baseline for 15m window. transitioning to "post-incident follow-up" state.

maria: closing here for live bridge. follow-ups: RCA draft, credit proposal, and isolation runbook. I'll capture owners and timeline in the doc and ping for approvals.

devon: closing the on-call ticket, leaving the mitigation flags in place until the quarantine migration completes.
